upgrades.label: Better diagnostics
upgrades.says: Every PATCH change is a little less likely to backfire.

upgrades.label: Regression checks
upgrades.says: PATCH tests before it touches anything: backfires get rarer again.

upgrades.label: Self-review
upgrades.says: PATCH reads its own plan back before running it. Much more reliable.

upgrades.label: Snapshot backups
upgrades.says: Adds the Backup safeguard: after a bad change you can restore the queue or roll back quickly.

upgrades.label: Deletion confirmation
upgrades.says: Adds the Confirm deletes safeguard: risky queue and cleanup actions halve their chance to backfire.

upgrades.label: Least privilege review
upgrades.says: PATCH checks each account against the requested role: permission backfires become less likely.

upgrades.label: Change limits
upgrades.says: Adds the Change cap safeguard: a backfire can hit at most two devices.

upgrades.label: Fast rollback
upgrades.says: Every recovery takes you half as long.

upgrades.label: Intent clarification
upgrades.says: PATCH asks what 'organise' means. Bulk misreads and false successes become much rarer.

upgrades.label: Ticket context
upgrades.says: Proposals show a much narrower, more honest risk estimate.

upgrades.label: Dependency checks
upgrades.says: PATCH checks what else a change touches. Dependency and wrong-target mistakes become rarer.

upgrades.label: Onboarding workflow
upgrades.says: PATCH can propose an automation that sets up new starters.

upgrades.label: Network remediation
upgrades.says: PATCH can propose an automation that watches and repairs the network.

upgrades.label: Building systems
upgrades.says: PATCH can propose a lift optimiser: a faster lift and fewer controller faults.

upgrades.label: Remote session
upgrades.says: PC tickets and site recoveries can be done from the IT desk, without walking.

upgrades.label: Repeat approved fixes
upgrades.says: PATCH repeats one-off fixes you approved on new tickets of the same kind, without asking. Each is still a risk.

upgrades.label: Bounded schedules
upgrades.says: Hourly automations run every half hour: twice the help, twice the exposure.
